---
applyTo: "src/data/**/*.ts"
---
All copy must match the voice defined in docs/BRAND_BIBLE.md: cold, blunt,
exclusive, unapologetic. No exclamation points, no emojis, no generic
e-commerce phrasing like "Shop Now" or "New Arrivals" without a harder edge
("Take What's Yours", "Not For Everyone", "Earned, Not Given").
